title: incident-bot: improve autodiagnostics ranking heuristics + add SLO toolkit utilities for prioritization
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context: on-call teams rely on incident-bot autodiagnostics to quickly triage SLO-related alerts. Current ranking tends to surface noisy or low-actionability diagnostics above higher-confidence signals for composite SLOs. This causes longer time-to-detect the underlying root cause and more manual work for oncall.

What this PR does: consolidates several heuristic improvements to autodiagnostics ranking in incident-bot and introduces small SLO toolkit utilities used by the ranking logic. Key changes are: (1) signal-weighted scoring for diagnostics (gives higher weight to signals from canonical SLOs and production routes), (2) temporal decay for repeated diagnostics to prefer novel signals during prolonged incidents, (3) oncall-priority boost for diagnostics that map to runbook steps with known remediation actions, and (4) new SLO prioritizer utilities to compute per-service priority buckets used by the bot.

Implementation notes: the ranking algorithm is implemented in incident-bot/src/diagnostics/ranking.py and kept backward compatible via a feature flag INCIDENTBOT_AUTODIAG_V2. The SLO utilities are added under slo-toolkit/src/prioritizer.py and include a small cache-backed mapping from linear SLO ids to priority scores. A lightweight migration in runbooks/playbook-linker adds the runbook->action mapping used by the oncall-priority boost.

Testing and validation: unit tests added under incident-bot/tests/test_ranking.py and slo-toolkit/tests/test_prioritizer.py. We ran a staging canary against production-like alert traffic for 72 hours and observed a 18% reduction in median time-to-action on SLO alerts and a 12% decrease in repeated noisy diagnostics shown to oncall. CI: all tests + lint + typecheck passed.

Rollout plan: default off. We will enable INCIDENTBOT_AUTODIAG_V2 for 10% of customers in prod for 48h, then ramp to 50% after monitoring key metrics (time-to-action, false-positive rate). Rollback plan: revert feature flag; ranking.py keeps previous algorithm behind flag to allow immediate fallback.

Related: ENG-3142 (autodiag ranking improvements), SRE-221 (oncall playbook prioritization).

diff_snippets:
+++ incident-bot/src/diagnostics/ranking.py
+def score_diagnostic(diag, slo_priority_map, runbook_actions):
+    score = base_score(diag) * slo_priority_map.get(diag.slo_id, 1.0)
+    if diag.signature in runbook_actions:
+        score *= 1.25  # boost actionable items
+    score *= temporal_decay(diag.last_seen)
+    return score

+++ slo-toolkit/src/prioritizer.py
+class Prioritizer:
+    def __init__(self, cache):
+        self._cache = cache
+    def priority_for(self, slo_id):
+        # stable mapping: critical -> 1.5, high -> 1.2, default 1.0
+        return self._cache.get(slo_id) or 1.0

release_notes: Improved autodiagnostics ranking to prioritize actionable and high-priority SLO signals; added SLO prioritizer utilities. Rollout controlled by INCIDENTBOT_AUTODIAG_V2 feature flag.
